{{Quote|What a delight to have landed amidst fellow twisters of life! Among the Kissai are the Ninûshwodzakut, whose title translates as 'Knotters of Entrails.'|An extract from the Chronicle of Sorzus Syn, 6899 BBY|<ref name="Book of Sith" />}}
The '''Ninûshwodzakut''' (which meant "Knotters of Entrails" in [[Sith (language)|Sith]]) were a group of [[Kissai]] whose role was to create [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawns]] through [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemy]] and manipulated breeding. Following the acquirement of the [[Holocron of King Nakgru]] in [[6899 BBY]],<ref name="Exile Second Year">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'' (p. 27) states that latter part of [[Sorzus Syn]]'s chronicle took place in the "Exile Year Two, Months 7-9". Per ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' the first year took place in [[6900 BBY]], thus the second year would be [[6899 BBY]].</ref> ''[[Jen'jidai]]'' [[Sorzus Syn]] visited [[Ziost's breeding pens|breeding pens]] of Ninûshwodzakut on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] and studied creation of [[Sithspawn/Legends|warbeasts]], including [[Silooth/Legends|silooth]], [[Sith warbird|warbirds]], [[Sith war behemoth|war behemoths]], [[hssiss]], [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]], [[Battle hydra/Legends|battle hydras]], [[chrysalide]]s, [[Sith wyrm|war wyrms]] and guardian beasts called [[Tuk'ata/Legends|tuk'ata]]. In her [[Sorzus Syn's chronicle|titular chronicle]], Syn remarked what a delight it was to land among the fellow alchemists.<ref name="Book of Sith" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ninûshwodzakut were first mentioned in the resource guide ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="Book of Sith" />
